messages:
olivia: Heads up — 3pm today we have 4 visitors from Apex Partners (CFO + 3). Need guest badges, a quiet seating area near the lobby (for a quick 3:15 product chat), and the catering drop-off at 2:30 held at the front desk. Can someone confirm badges + space? Thanks!
frontdesk-bot: LOG: Catering Co package incoming, tracking `CAT-01234`. ETA 14:30. Will hold at front desk. :package:
tom: Can we snag the small conference room by the kitchen? It's quieter.
maria: Conference Room A is free 14:30–16:00, I can reserve it and put up a 'Quiet — Meeting in progress' sign. I'll print temp badges when front desk confirms. :thumbsup:
alex: I can shift the modular tables to make a reception-style layout near the lobby couch. Will do at 14:15.
carlos: Visitor wifi: use SSID `Redwood-Guest` password `redwood-guest2026`. Security policy: internet-only access.
olivia: Awesome. @frontdesk-bot can you confirm badge printing time? Also who can meet them at the door?
frontdesk-bot: BADGES queued. Print time 14:50. Badge IDs: `V-998`,`V-999`,`V-1000`,`V-1001`. Please collect from desk.
security-bot: Pre-check done. Visitors cleared for 90m meeting window. Escort recommended. Reminder: no cameras in secure areas.
jess: I can meet them at the lobby at 14:55 and walk them to the room.
olivia: Perfect — thanks everyone :raised_hands: I'll leave a note in the calendar invite with the escort. Also, catering label says 'Contains sesame' — heads up for allergies.
maria: Noted. I'll put out a small label card and a GF option.
tom: Great — also FYI there's a stray package on bench labeled 'dev kits' — anyone know if that's for eng-demo?
alex: I moved the dev kits to storage locker A and left a sticky note on bench 3.
olivia: Thanks alex. All set here.
